configuredBudget.policy: Existing USD 0.05 per-trial SDK estimate guard. Stop starting new trials at observed USD 1.80; retain planned but unexecuted trials and missing usage. Estimates are not invoice caps. Canary and global budgets are separate.

accountingLimit: Observed SDK estimates and event reconciliation do not establish invoice, hidden retry or complete request/cache accounting. Failed and unreconciled trials remain included.
